content: 'Ananiyaxi meta Tsapira 'axakememɨte'uyuri
Xewitɨta tewi 'Ananiyaxi titewatɨ yɨ'ɨitatɨ Tsapira hamatɨa yukwie mekaniutuani,
'ɨyayata yatimaikaku, 'etsiwa kaniyuhayewieni kemɨreituakai, yapaɨmeme xeikɨa, nɨ'ariekate wahetsɨa kani'atɨani.
Hikɨ Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Neuxei, 'Ananiyaxi, ¿titayari kauyumarie 'a'iyari tinɨ'ɨ, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata pemɨtiu'itaikɨ, yapaɨmeme pemauku'ɨikɨ kwie pemetua hetsiemieme?

Kepauka mɨ'akwietɨkai katini'apiinitɨkaitɨni. Peheituaka 'akuxi heitserie pepexeiyakai hepaɨtsitana. ¿Ketitayari 'a'iyaritsie mɨyapetiu'ahɨawixɨ? 'Ekɨ teɨteri pepɨkatiwaru'itai, matsi pɨta Kakaɨyari pekatiniu'itaiya.
'Ikɨ niuki 'u'enieka, 'Ananiyaxi 'atiweka pumɨ. Mepɨmamakai yemekɨ yunaitɨ me'u'enanaka.
Hikɨ temari me'anuku'uka hipatɨ me'iku'eimaka mekaneikweni me'ikateukuke.
Hikɨ haika hurayari 'aye'aku 'ɨyaya kaninuani 'atsikatimaitɨ kemɨtiuyɨkai.
Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: —¿Yakenetineutahɨawi, yukwie mɨyapaɨmemekɨ xeikɨa xetehetua? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Huu, mɨpaɨ kanipaɨmekaitɨni.
Pekuru mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Titayari xeteyu'eni xemita'inɨatakɨ Ti'aitame 'Iyarieya? Neuxei 'akɨna teukumete mana kitenie mekaniuti'uka, 'ekɨta mekamenanukweikuni.
Yapauka mɨkɨ kanatiweni Pekuru hɨxie kaniumɨni. Hikɨ temari meheutahaxɨaka mɨkime mekaniutaxeiya. Meheikweka kɨnaya 'aurie mekaneikateuku.
Waɨkawa mepɨmamakai mana memɨyutixexeɨriwakai, yunaitɨ metehetimaika 'ikɨ kemɨtiuyɨ.
Nɨ'ariekate 'inɨari mariwemekɨ kememɨte'uyuri
Nɨ'ariekate wamamakɨ waɨkawa 'inɨarikɨ meta mamariwaweme katiniuyɨni teɨteri wahɨxie, yunaitɨ yurimemɨte'erie 'axeikɨa mekaniu'uwakaitɨni Tsarumuni 'Etɨpiwarieya meukuwewiya hetɨa.
Hipatɨ teɨteri mewamakatɨ wahamatɨa mepɨka'u'uwakai, tsepatɨtɨ yemekɨ 'aixɨa memutiyuanekai wahepaɨtsita.
Yumɨiretɨ mepakɨnirɨmekai yuri memɨte'uta'eriwakaikɨ Ti'aitame hetsie.
Mepɨyuwaɨkawakairi 'ukitsi meta 'ukarawetsixi yaxeikɨata tekwikwikate huyeta meputuarieximekai 'utatsie meta 'itsitsie me'aheitɨ, Pekuru tsikeretsɨ 'etɨrieya mana wahetsie tiunakeke.
Yumɨiretɨta Kerutsareme 'aurie kiekatari tekwikwikate mekaniwa'atɨwakaitɨni, meta kakaɨyarixi 'axamemɨ'anene memɨwa'uximatɨakai, yunaitɨ 'aixɨa meteheu'erietɨ mepakɨ.
Pekuru meta Wani kememɨte'utaweiyarie
Hikɨ mawari wewiwame tiwa'aitɨwame meta mana memɨhɨritɨarie me'anuku'uka, yunaitɨ mɨkɨ memɨtsarutseutsixitɨkai, mekaniwaruti'uxiwe'erieni.
Hikɨ nɨ'ariekate mekaniutiwiyarieni, katsariyanata mepɨwaranutaxɨri.
Matsi tɨkarikɨ niuki tuayame Yawe hetsɨa mieme katsariyanata pɨreuyepiexɨa, pɨwaranuyewitɨ.
Mɨpaɨ tiwakɨhɨawetɨ: «Xekenehu, tuki manuwe muwa xeketeniwakuxaxatɨwani teɨteri naime tewi tukari kemɨrexeiyani hepaɨtsita».

Mɨkɨ me'u'enanaka kememɨte'utahɨawarie, tukita ximeripaɨtɨ mekaneutahaxɨani, muwa mekateni'ɨkitakaitɨni. Kepauka mawari wewiwame tiwa'aitɨwame meta mana memɨhɨritɨarie, meta wahamatɨa memu'uwakai me'u'axɨaka, 'itsɨkate yunaime 'Ixaheri xiɨyarimama 'ukirawetsixi mekaniwarutaxatɨani. Tupiritsixi mekaniwarutanɨ'ani katsariyanata paitɨ memɨwahapayukɨ.
Tupiritsixi me'u'axɨaka mepɨkawarutaxei katsariyanata. Yu'utɨa me'akunuaxɨaka, mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutaxatɨani:
«Neuxei katsariyana tepetaxei 'aixɨa rekunakame, tehɨwemete kitenie mepeti'ukai, perutsɨ teteheuyepieka nixeime tepɨkahetaxei kiita».
Tupiritsixi tiwa'aitɨwame tukita tihɨweme, meta mawari wewiwamete tewa'atɨwamete me'u'enanaka mekaniuhɨxiyani, 'atsimepɨkatemaikai wahepaɨtsita kemɨtiuyɨ.
'Ana xewitɨ nuaka katiniwarutahekɨatɨani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Neuxei mɨkɨ 'ukitsi xemɨwaranutaxɨri, mɨkɨ tuki kuraruyarita mepɨtehekuxata teɨteri meteware'ɨkitɨatɨ».
Hikɨ tehɨwemete tiwa'aitɨwame kaneyani meta 'iparewiwametemama, hau'erietɨ mekawarahapatɨ mekaniwa'atɨani, teɨteri memɨwamakarɨkaikɨ tetekɨ mewarutituaxakɨ.
Hikɨ mewa'atɨaka 'itsɨkate wahɨxie mekaniwati'uitɨani, mawari wewiwame mɨhɨritɨarie

mɨpaɨ katiniwarutatieni: —Tame tamɨ tepɨtexe'uta'imaiyakai xemɨkate'ɨkitanikɨ mɨkɨ kemɨtitewa hetsiemieme. Matsi pɨta, xeme Kerutsareme yɨ'ɨkitɨarikakɨ xepɨte'utihɨniyaxɨ, xeme tahetsie xepɨte'ahɨpa mɨkɨ tewi xuriyayakɨ.
Pekuru meta nɨ'ariekate mɨpaɨ mekateniwaruta'eiya: —Peuyewetse matsi Kakaɨyari temɨ'eniekakɨ, keyuri teɨteri memɨtate'aitɨakakɨ.
Tatutsima wakakaɨyari Ketsutsi kananukuketɨani, xeme xekanimieni kɨyetsie xe'ikuwieka.
Kakaɨyari yɨtɨrɨkariyakɨ kanenutiwitɨni yutserieta kaneyeni Ti'aitame meta Tiyuwikweitsitɨwame, mɨxepitɨanikɨ 'ixaheritsixi xemɨtehayewanikɨ kexemɨteyurie, xemɨteheuyehɨwiyarienikɨ.
Tame tekanihɨkɨtɨni temunenierixɨ temɨtehekɨata 'ikɨ kemɨtiuyɨ hepaɨtsita, mɨpaɨta katinihekɨatani 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata Kakaɨyari mɨwarupitɨa mɨkɨ memi'enie.
Mɨkɨ me'u'enanaka mekaniuyeha'ani mekaniwakwikukaitɨni.

Peru xewitɨ 'anukukeka memayuxeɨrietsie paritseu mɨhɨkɨtɨkai, Kamarieri mɨtitewakai, 'inɨari niukiyarikɨ ti'ɨkitame mɨhɨkɨtɨkai, mariweme memɨ'eriekai yunaitɨ teɨteri, katiniuta'aita memɨwaranuyenɨ'anikɨ takwa paitɨ mɨkɨ teɨteri,
mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Neuxei 'ixaheritsixi, yumarima 'aixɨa kexemɨteyurieni 'ikɨ teɨteri wahepaɨtsita.

Meripaitɨ panukuke Teuraxi, ya'utaitɨ kename yɨwemetɨkai, nauka tsienituyari 'ukitsi yakɨtɨtɨ hetsiena mekateniwiyakaitɨni. Peru mɨkɨ pumierie, yunaitɨ memi'eniekai mepeutaxɨriexɨa, tixaɨ mepɨkate'akɨ.
'Arikeketa kananukukeni Kura karereyatanaka kepauka memaka'utsie, teɨteri yumɨireme kaniwarewitɨni yu'utɨma. Mɨkɨta pumierie, yunaitɨ memi'eniekai mepeutayeixɨa.
Hikɨri mɨpaɨ nepaine, xekeniwaruhayewa 'ikɨ teɨteri, xekeniwarutixɨna. Kememɨteku'eriwa meta kememɨteyurie xɨka teɨteri wahetsɨa miemetɨni mekatenihayewakeyu.
Mexɨka Kakaɨyari hetsɨa miemetɨni, xepɨkayɨwawe xemɨwata'imaiya, tietɨtsɨ Kakaɨyari xe'aye'unieka». Merikɨtsɨ mekani'enieni.
Yuhetsɨa mewarutahɨaweka nɨ'ariekate mewarutiwaka mɨpaɨ mekateniwaruta'aitɨani memɨkatiniunikɨ Ketsutsi hetsɨa memiemetetɨtɨ. Mekaniwarutixɨna.
'Itsɨkate wahetsɨa mekaniwayenexɨani meyutemamawietɨ, Kakaɨyari meyɨwaweme mɨwa'eriekaikɨ memɨtawe'eriwanikɨ hetsɨana memɨmiemetetɨkaikɨ.
Tukarikɨ tukita yukiiteta mepɨkatehayewakai mete'ɨkitatɨ metekuxatatɨ niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne kename Ketsutsi heitserie hexeiya Kɨritsitutɨtɨ me'utiyuatɨ.
